headline: Passage Erupts as Shelf and Expanse Battles Rage
war_summary: Since the 18:10 edition the centre has shifted to Callahan's Passage, which records five changes in two hours against none before, the latest at the cutoff, centred on The Crumbling Passage and The Latch with holdings at nine Warden, none Colonial and one neutral and both casualty rates accelerating sharply. Fisherman's Row has eased to three changes in two hours and 39 on the day about Eidolo, Dankana Post and Black Well, with holdings now seven Warden and two Colonial and casualty rates still accelerating. Stlican Shelf remains busy with four changes in two hours and 47 on the day about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, holdings four Warden and five Colonial, while Weathered Expanse posts three in two hours and 52 on the day about Wightwalk, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest at four Warden and five Colonial. Linn Mercy adds three in two hours about Lathair. Marban Hollow, Mooring County and Nevish Line show no change in the last two hours, with Nevish Line still reporting sharply accelerating casualties.
